checkRuns.command:
cat > src/routes/contact.kay <<'EOF'
--- server
import { t } from 'kay'
import { checkContact } from '../contact'
import ContactForm from '../components/contact-form.kay'

const contactMessage = t.Object({
  name: t.String({ maxLength: 200 }),
  email: t.String({ maxLength: 320 }),
  message: t.String({ maxLength: 5000 }),
})

export const contact = action(contactMessage, (input, ctx) => {
  const errors = checkContact(input)

  if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0)
    return ctx.fail(422, { errors })

  return { name: input.name.trim() }
})
---
head
  title Contact
h1 Contact
ContactForm
EOF
cat > src/components/contact-form.kay <<'EOF'
---
import { contact } from '../routes/contact.kay'
import { checkContact } from '../contact'
import type { ContactErrors } from '../contact'

const errors = signal<ContactErrors>(contact.failed()?.data?.errors ?? {})
const thanked = signal(contact.succeeded()?.data.name ?? '')

async function submit(event: SubmitEvent) {
  event.preventDefault()
  const form = event.currentTarget as HTMLFormElement
  const fields = new FormData(form)
  const found = checkContact({
    name: String(fields.get('name') ?? ''),
    email: String(fields.get('email') ?? ''),
    message: String(fields.get('message') ?? ''),
  })

  errors.set(found)
  thanked.set('')

  if (Object.keys(found).length === 0) {
    thanked.set((await contact(fields, { refresh: false })).name)
    form.reset()
  }
}
---
if thanked
  p(role="status") Thanks, {thanked}! Your message has been sent.
form(action={contact} method="post" novalidate onSubmit={submit})
  div
    label(for="name") Name
    input#name(type="text" name="name")
    if errors.name
      p.error#name-error {errors.name}
  div
    label(for="email") Email
    input#email(type="email" name="email")
    if errors.email
      p.error#email-error {errors.email}
  div
    label(for="message") Message
    textarea#message(name="message")
    if errors.message
      p.error#message-error {errors.message}
  button(type="submit") Send
EOF
bun run check

bun run build 2>&1 | tail -15 && (PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 2 && for p in / /books /books/frankenstein /books/nope /about /contact /zzz; do echo "== $p"; curl -s -o /tmp/out.html -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:4701$p; sed -e 's/<script.*<\/script>//g' /tmp/out.html | grep -o '<title>.*</title>\|<body.*' | head -c 2500; echo; done

cat > src/server.ts <<'EOF'
import process from 'node:process'
import { Elysia } from 'elysia'
import { pages } from 'kay/server'

// kay reads the site's own URL from `SITE_URL`; the deployment gives it as `ORIGIN`.
if (process.env.SITE_URL === undefined && process.env.ORIGIN !== undefined)
  process.env.SITE_URL = process.env.ORIGIN

// Exported for `kay check`, which checks links against the routes it serves besides the pages and types `ctx.locals` from its plugins.
export const app = new Elysia().use(await pages()).listen({
  port: Number(process.env.PORT ?? 3000),
  hostname: process.env.HOST ?? '0.0.0.0',
})

console.log(`Listening on http://${app.server?.hostname}:${app.server?.port}`)
EOF
pkill -f "bun src/server.ts"; sleep 0.5; bun run check && (PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 2; cd /tmp; rm -f jar; A=/_kay/action/src/routes/contact.kay/contact
